meta.purpose: Phase 1 research — review with user before catalog ingest
meta.notes: Prospector has a single mining head (hardpointIndex 0). Hofstede-S1 has 1 module port; Helix I has 2 module ports; Lancet MH1 has 1 module port.

namingConvention.jobDesignation: Purpose / job title — NOT a hardware stack label. Examples: General, Max Breaker, Surface Breaker, Quantanium, Beginner.
namingConvention.moduleTierNote: XL modules = MK3 grade in game files (e.g. XTR-XL → Mining_Modules_Passive_XTR_MK3). XL tier is −5% module power vs −10% (L) / −15% (base).
namingConvention.variantRule: A variant is a build mostly the same as another (e.g. iron vs titanium tweak). Distinct module combos with different jobs are separate standalone catalog entries, not variants.

audience.solo: Single-seat ship — always solo unless noted

buildTaxonomy.partial: Single-head ship — partial only when guide omits the one module port

candidates.creator: GGWTB

sources.title: Star Citizen 4.7 Mining Loadouts: Best MOLE & Prospector Builds

candidates.description: Default 4.7 recommendation for most players — Hofstede-S1 trades raw power for the widest forgiving green zone.
candidates.purposeRationale: Hofstede + Focus III: ~2,000 stock power but +100% optimal-window bonus (60% head + 40% Focus). Best general-purpose starter when window control matters more than peak DPS.

candidates.creator: GGWTB
candidates.description: Always-on breaker: Helix I with Rieger-C3 on both ports — no actives, no window help. For miners who can hold a narrow green zone on tough rocks.
candidates.purposeRationale: Double Rieger-C3 on Helix I ≈ 4,725 passive laser power (1.50× stock 3,150) — highest always-on Prospector DPS. Optimal window ≈ −42% (Helix −40% + Rieger penalties). Job = sustained passive breaking, not burst.
executiveDecisions: 'Rieger-C3 / Ryer C3' read as two Helix I module ports both Rieger-C3 — Ryer is misspelling of Rieger, not a second module type

candidates.creator: Loud Guns
candidates.description: Balanced 4.7 daily driver — Rieger-C3 power with Focus III window recovery on Helix I.
candidates.purposeRationale: Rieger + Focus on Helix I ≈ 3,780 passive power (1.20×) with optimal window near neutral (~−1%). Loud Guns's recommended general-purpose Helix build.

candidates.creator: Loud Guns
candidates.description: Maximum Prospector breaking power — Helix I with Rieger-C3 passive baseline and Surge active burst for large, high-resistance rocks.
candidates.purposeRationale: Rieger + Surge (Surge active) ≈ 5,513 laser power (1.75× stock 3,150) — highest peak power achievable on a Prospector. Narrow window (~−41%); job is hard-rock breaking when you can manage instability during Surge.

candidates.creator: Loud Guns
candidates.description: No passives — Surge + Stampede double-active burst for experienced miners who cycle actives instead of holding a passive baseline.
candidates.purposeRationale: Surge + Stampede (both active) ≈ 4,253 peak power (1.35×) — lower peak than Max Breaker (Rieger+Surge) but dual actives with Stampede instability reduction (−10%) during burst windows. Distinct job: active cycling, not max DPS.

candidates.creator: Loud Guns
candidates.description: Learner build — Hofstede-S1 wide window with a modest Rieger-C3 power bump for smaller rocks while learning throttle control.
candidates.purposeRationale: Hofstede + Rieger ≈ 2,625 power (1.25×) with +59% optimal window. More power than pure Focus beginner setups but still forgiving — distinct from GGWTB General (Focus) and from Helix progression builds.

candidates.creator: Noob Citizen
candidates.sourcePublishedHint: Legacy quant guide — volatility mechanics may differ in 4.7+
candidates.description: Quantanium specialist — Lancet MH1 for narrow-window volatile extraction; carry spare Surge charges in utility slots.
candidates.purposeRationale: Lancet MH1 (−10% instability, −60% window) + Surge for timed bursts on quantanium. Ore-specific job, not a general Helix/Hofstede progression build.

carriedConsumables.note: Guide equips Surge to 2+ utility sub-item slots for spare charges; only 1 mounts on Lancet's single module port

candidates.mappingNotes: Active Surge inventory vs laser port — catalog should document carried spares separately from laser module multiset match

candidates.creator: Sinedrone
candidates.description: Surface breaker — Helix I with XTR-XL on both ports. Planetary surface rocks only; uses XL window widening to tame Helix's narrow charge zone, not power modules.
candidates.purposeRationale: Double XTR-XL (MK3): −5% power each (−10% total) ≈ 2,835 MW; optimal charge window −40% Helix + 50% XTR = +10%. Chosen for XL-tier window recovery on a breaker head — not for filter/extraction side stats. Distinct from asteroid Rieger/Surge power builds.

candidates.creator: Sinedrone
candidates.description: Surface Hofstede with FLTR-XL — cut inert pulled into the Prospector's small hold after you crack the rock. Does not change inert inside the rock; reduces garbage collected during extraction so you mine longer before filling on junk.
candidates.purposeRationale: FLTR-XL (MK3): +24 inert filter, −5% power, +0% charge window. Prospector cargo is tight on surface loops — filter lowers inert sucked up post-break (extraction phase), not pre-break rock composition. Hofstede's native +60% window unchanged. Pick over XTR-XL when hold efficiency matters more than extra green zone.
candidates.mappingNotes: Inert filter affects extraction yield mix after fracture — not the inert content of the rock itself.

candidates.creator: Sinedrone
candidates.description: Easy surface Hofstede — XTR-XL when surface rocks need more green zone than stock Hofstede alone. Same −5% XL power penalty; +25% charge window on top of the head's +60%.
candidates.purposeRationale: XTR-XL (MK3): −5% power, +25% charge window. Hofstede effective window +85%. Chosen for XL window widening on forgiving surface runs. Swap with Surface Filter (FLTR-XL) when hold capacity / less extraction garbage matters more than extra green zone.
